laneContinuityPolicy.secondCompactionAction: complete health audit; continue only if authority remains clear
laneContinuityPolicy.thirdCompactionAction: commit a safe Git checkpoint; finish only the current small/atomic boundary and do not start a new large task
laneContinuityPolicy.fourthCompactionAction: enter pre-handoff; finish the current atomic task and handoff preparation only, with no new large task
controllerRequiredActions: send follow-up for allowed small work
record a real blocker and wait for external input

dualPathCompletionReporting.primary: The active Integration apply owner must immediately call send_message_to_thread after every completed OpenSpec task, task group, clean checkpoint, blocker, deviation, handoff, activation, or delivery event, then call read_thread to confirm receipt by the authoritative Controller task.
dualPathCompletionReporting.fallback: The project-level continuity automation checks every 15 minutes for progress or HEAD changes lacking a matching direct Controller message and requests an immediate catch-up report.
dualPathCompletionReporting.successorInheritance: Every successor created after the fifth observable compaction or an early health handoff must receive this full reporting contract in its creation prompt, registration, acceptance, and sole-owner activation. Acceptance is invalid until the successor acknowledges the contract.
